item.title: X-62A Toting Infrared Search And Track Pod Used Its AI ‘Brain’ To Autonomously Intercept An ‘Enemy’ T-38
item.summary: Being able to autonomously use onboard sensor data to engage aerial threats is exactly what the USAF wants from its future CCA drones. The post X-62A Toting Infrared Search And Track Pod Used Its AI ‘Brain’ To Autonomously Intercept An ‘Enemy’ T-38 appeared first on TWZ .
